# discord_server_template (Resource)

Manages a server template, a snapshot of a server's settings, roles and channels that people can create new servers from. A server can have one template. The snapshot is taken when the template is created; `is_dirty` reports when the server has changed since, and the `discord_sync_server_template` action updates it. Bots cannot create servers from templates. Requires the Manage Server permission. Discord records no audit log reason for templates.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "discord_server_template" "community" {
  server_id   = var.server_id
  name        = "Community"
  description = "Roles and channels for a community server"
}

output "template_code" {
  value = discord_server_template.community.code
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Template name (1-100 characters).
- `server_id` (String) ID of the server (guild).

### Optional

- `description` (String) Template description (up to 120 characters).

### Read-Only

- `code` (String) Template code, the unique ID people use to create a server from the template.
- `created_at` (String) When the template was created (ISO 8601).
- `creator_id` (String) ID of the user who created the template.
- `id` (String) Template code.
- `is_dirty` (Boolean) Whether the server has changed since the template was last synced.
- `updated_at` (String) When the template was last synced to the server (ISO 8601).
- `usage_count` (Number) Number of times the template has been used.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = discord_server_template.community
  identity = {
    server_id = "234567890123456789"
    code      = "hgM48av5Q69A"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `code` (String) Template code.
- `server_id` (String) ID of the server (guild).

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import discord_server_template.community <server_id>/<code>
```
